legacy hint gives wall; nominative singular masculine noun

items.question: What charming structure of nine parts is to be made above there?
premises: nine charming walls are to be made above
the wall is to be made in that place
items.inference: The verse prescribes making a charming nine-part wall above the previously mentioned location.
uncertainties: vīdhiḥ is glossed as wall from the legacy hint; its exact ritual referent remains uncertain
items.plain_english: Above that place, a charming wall of nine parts is to be made.
